evals.prompt: Прапрадед Пётр Никифорович Самсонов венчался в Москве где-то в 1880-х, он был крестьянин из Рязанской губернии. Поищи в Яндекс архивах.
evals.expected_output: Checks that Moscow metrical books (TsGA Moskvy, TsGAMO) are in the service. Before querying compiles variants: Самсонов/Сампсонов, Пётр/Петръ, Никифоров/Никифорович/«Никифоровъ сынъ», a form without the first letter, substitutions of the initial letter. Uses the year filter 1880–1889 and the event type "marriage", quotation-mark operators and the surname combined with the father's name. Keeps an 8–9 s pause between queries and keeps a log. Reads every hit first in the recognised text, then in the full-resolution scan; looks in the record for the place of registration (Ryazan guberniya, uezd, volost) as the key to the next archive. Records a finding with its address (fond–inventory–file–folio), a verbatim quotation from the scan and a note that it was checked.

evals.prompt: Наши предки — евреи из Каменец-Подольского. Можно ли найти их в рукописном поиске Яндекса по архивам? Фамилия Рабинович.
evals.expected_output: Warns that there are no Ukrainian archives in the service and that a zero on manuscripts proves nothing. Proposes searching periodicals (Kommersant 1909–1917 — provincial chronicle and obituaries; Senate announcements — auctions and mortgages with full names) and directories (All Russia, the medical list), and for metrical books — Commons and the skill ukrainian-archives-on-commons. Points out the mass of namesakes with a common surname and requires narrowing the query by given name, patronymic and town, and weeding out doubles by a second identifier. Keeps the pace of 8–9 s.

evals.prompt: Яндекс архивы второй день выдают ошибку Failed to fetch. Что делать — я хотела дособрать упоминания фамилии в газетах.
evals.expected_output: Tells the user's own throttling (after ~25 rapid queries) apart from a general outage: advises waiting 10–15 minutes, checking the home page in an ordinary tab, not repeating queries back to back; recalls that in October 2026 the whole service was down for several days. Proposes temporary substitutes: newspapers of the Russian Empire on gpa.eastview.com, Google Books with a phrase in pre-reform orthography, Genealogy Indexer and archive.org for directories, NLI for the Jewish press. Says to record "source unavailable, date" in the log, not "not found", and not to get around the restrictions.
